Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Hi there,
I was asking myself who is behind JOL and who has the source code or documentation of it?

I think JOL's missing the following commands:  random discard from hand.
Currently, we're obliged to label cards, call random X times, discard labelled cards.
Suggested syntax: discard 3 random move to top of the library.
Useful for some cards such as Sudario's Refraction, Hourglass of the Mind. Currently, we're obliged to move them to the uncontrolled region and label them.
Suggested syntax: move [SRCPLAYER] [SRCREGION] CARD [DESTPLAYER] [TOP] [DESTREGION] [DESTCARD], eg. move hand 3 top library choose secret value
Useful for cards such as Malkavian Prank (where users must choose a secret number of pool). There's currently no way of doing this except sending some mails to a trusted person that will check and send back results
Suggested syntax: secret [VALUE]
and reveal [PLAYER].  Eg. > secret 3
Ankha has chosen a secret value
> reveal (or reveal Ankha)
Ankha had chosen: 3

And I'd like a command like 'burn X' that would be a shortcut for 'move X ash'.

Also, some commands could be expanded, such as discard:
discard CARD1 CARD2 ... CARDn [draw]
In order to discard multiple cards at the same time. Typing n commands is long and can be tricky sometimes because the card number may change if you're not careful.

Given the source code, I think I could develop this quite easily.

I'd also like to know if JOL exposes some web service in order to develop a JOL application for mobile phone.

That's all!

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
